clips.title: The story
paras: At the Crossroads, Devrak keeps the Horde’s wind riders ready for the roads across Kalimdor. The orc flight master carries couriers and supplies between Durotar, Mulgore, frontier outposts, and the Horde’s capitals.

At the Crossroads, Devrak tends the wind riders that link the Horde’s far-flung holdings. The outpost stands where Kalimdor’s major trade routes meet, exposed beneath the sun and vulnerable to quilboar, centaur, and Alliance scouts. Quick flights matter here. Devrak pairs seasoned travelers and new messengers with trained wind riders that cross the savannah and reach Mulgore’s mountains or Durotar’s stone canyons.

Devrak also helps move supplies from the frontier. Barrens hunters bring in meat and pelts, and he helps send them to Orgrimmar’s cooking fires and Thunder Bluff’s tanners. He introduces new couriers to flight masters across the continents, keeping an aerial route open to the Horde’s heartlands.

Devrak tends more than beasts at the Crossroads. When the settlement comes under attack, he calls enraged wyverns to strike intruders with venomous stingers and talons. His roost is a dangerous target for anyone who attacks.
